comparison.objective: Remove an old printer cartridge, insert a new one on keyed rails, and close the door.
comparison.physical_skill: Wide cartridge extraction, keyed rail insertion, seating, and door operation.
comparison.success_condition: Old cartridge rests outside, new cartridge is seated, door shut, and arms clear for one second.
comparison.reason: Consumable exchange through guide rails does not test angular stop calibration or locking-reaction compensation.
